label: sec:archimedean-condition-genus-completeness-genus-ideal-characterisation-preamble
html: The geometric truncation of two-strand torus knots at genus g = 4 has an exact algebraic counterpart in the Iwahori–Hecke algebra: the genus filtration forms a finitely generated ascending chain of ideals controlled by the Yekutieli leading coefficient. This section characterizes the genus ideal, proves that the torus-embeddable knots span its generation closure, and shows how the trefoil and cinquefoil channels exhaust the primary homological degrees on \Sigma_4.
